full_text:
QUOTA OF PROFESSORS AND ASSOCIATE PROFESSORS RESPONSIBLE FOR DEGREE-PROGRAM EDUCATION AT THE KOREA NATIONAL DEFENSE UNIVERSITY
(Under Article 12 (1))

Annex to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University [Amended Oct. 8, 2024]

Category | Authorized number of professors and associate professors
Total | 61
Professors and associate professors who are military personnel | 28
Professors and associate professors who are civilian employees of the military | 7
Professors and associate professors who are special-service national public officials other than military personnel or civilian employees of the military | 26
